app.title: FOMOD DB Explorer
app.subtitle: Browse all FOMOD mods and their options from the FOMOD+ database
search.placeholder: Search mod names, steps, groups, options...
patches.search.placeholder: Type a mod name (e.g. 'SkyUI', 'AI Overhaul') to find patches across ALL FOMODs...
patches.empty.title: Find patches across all FOMOD mods
patches.empty.body:
Type a mod name above and click "Find Patches" to search every option in every FOMOD in the database.
Useful for checking which FOMODs have a compatibility patch for a specific mod.
patches.results.summary: Found {total} matching options in {mods} FOMOD mods for query "{query}"
patches.no_matches.title: No matches found
patches.no_matches.body: No options found containing "{query}" in any FOMOD.
empty.no_db.title: No FOMOD database found
empty.no_db.body:
Make sure FOMOD+ is installed and you have installed at least one mod with a FOMOD installer.
Then click "Reload DB".
empty.no_matches.title: No matches
empty.error.title: Error loading data
footer.credits: FOMOD DB Explorer - a companion tool for FOMOD+
deps.unified.title: FOMOD Options with Dependencies
deps.unified.description: Each option below requires plugin files (.esp/.esm) as masters. Status: ❌ missing masters (can't use), ✅ selected + all masters active (already applied), ⚠️ not selected + all masters active (reinstall to apply).
deps.description: Checks FOMOD options' masters against your active plugins
deps.empty.title: Dependency Analyzer
deps.empty.body: Click "Analyze Dependencies" to check every FOMOD option's required masters against your currently active plugins. Missing dependencies will be highlighted so you know which patches you can't use yet.
deps.analyzing: Analyzing... this may take a few seconds
deps.no_plugins.title: No active plugins detected
deps.no_plugins.body: MO2 couldn't detect any active plugins. Make sure your game is configured and plugins are enabled in the right pane. The analysis below will show all options as missing since there are no active plugins to match against.
deps.summary.title: Summary
deps.cycles.title: Cyclic Dependencies Detected
deps.cycles.description: These are circular dependencies (A requires B, B requires A). While mutual patching is common and usually harmless, true cycles can cause installation order issues.
deps.graph.title: Dependency Graph
deps.graph.description: Most depended-upon mods across all FOMOD options in the database.
deps.missing.title: Options with Missing Dependencies
deps.missing.description: These FOMOD options require plugin files (.esp/.esm) that are NOT currently active in your load order. If you select these options, they won't work correctly.
deps.all_ok.title: All Dependencies Satisfied
deps.all_ok.body: Every FOMOD option that has masters has all of them active in your load order. Nothing is missing!
deps.unselected.title: Unselected patches with all masters active
deps.unselected.description: These FOMOD options have ALL their required masters active in your load order, but you didn't select them when you installed the FOMOD. You should reinstall the FOMOD to apply these patches.
deps.unselected.reinstall_suggested: ⚠ All masters are active — reinstall the FOMOD to select this patch
deps.comment.prompt: Enter a comment for this option (empty to remove):
patchdetect.description: Checks your active .esp files against FOMOD options that reference them
patchdetect.empty.title: Patch Detector
patchdetect.empty.body: Click "Detect Patches Needed" to check if any of your active .esp files are referenced by FOMOD options you didn't select. This tells you which FOMODs you should reinstall to apply patches for mods you installed later.
patchdetect.analyzing: Detecting... this may take a few seconds
patchdetect.no_plugins.title: No active plugins detected
patchdetect.no_plugins.body: MO2 couldn't detect any active plugins. Make sure your game is configured and plugins are enabled in the right pane.
patchdetect.summary.title: Summary
patchdetect.details.title: Active .esp files with FOMOD patches
patchdetect.details.description: Each .esp below is currently active in your load order AND is referenced as a master by at least one FOMOD option. Options marked "Reinstall suggested" were NOT selected when you installed that FOMOD — you should reinstall it to apply the patch.
patchdetect.no_patches.title: No patches found
patchdetect.no_patches.body: None of your active .esp files are referenced by any FOMOD option in the database. Either you don't have any mods that need patching, or all available patches were already selected.
guide.intro: This tab lets you save and restore your FOMOD installation state. Use "Export" to generate a JSON file containing every FOMOD mod in your database together with its selected options, files, masters and patch references. Use "Import" to load a previously saved file. Tick the checkbox on each mod to mark it as already installed — your progress is saved automatically per profile.
guide.empty.title: Backup
guide.empty.body: Click "Export Backup" to generate a backup of your current FOMOD database, or "Import Backup" to load a previously saved JSON file.
guide.no_data.title: No guide loaded
guide.no_data.body: Import a guide JSON file to see the installation plan.
